Email via SMTP and Mailpit

What SMTP actually does, and how nodemailer plus a local Mailpit container deliver a real (if fake) email for every domain event.

  • What SMTP Actually Does

    Sending mail and reading mail are two different protocols — nodemailer, and this project, only ever need the one that sends.

  • A nodemailer Transport, and Mailpit

    config/mailer.js: one shared SMTP transport, pointed at a local Mailpit container instead of a real mail server or an external dev-inbox provider.

  • Sending Through the Email Listener

    notifyEmail.listener.js: the same domainEvents.on() shape as the in-app channel, calling transport.sendMail() instead of prisma.notification.create().
